name: erythropoietin receptor

function.text: EPOR encodes erythropoietin receptor. Annotated molecular activities include erythropoietin receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and erythropoietin-mediated signaling pathway.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to primary familial polycythemia due to EPO receptor mutation (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
